description: If a machine has halted at input \(x\) and time \(t\), then \(R_M(x,t+j)=R_M(x,t)\) for every \(j\in\mathbb N\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run_absorbing
  (M : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.Machine) (x t j : ℕ)
  (h : M.halt (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x t) = true) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x (t + j) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.run M x t
